title: Portuguese Chicken Fajitas
description: A vegetarian twist on classic chicken fajitas. Sizzling stir-fry with tender and spicy vegetables.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of stir-fry sauce and swirl to coat the pan.
Add the sliced onions and cook for 3-4 minutes, until they start to soften.
Add the sliced peppers and cook for an additional 3-4 minutes, until they start to soften.
Add the canned tomatoes, fajita seasoning, and stir-fry sauce. Stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the vegetables are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro and lime wedges.
Offer warm flour or corn tortillas on the side for wrapping.
